requests.title: Rate-limit user- and network-driven reconciliation reads to INV-04 (Rehearsal 8 DEV-R8-11)
requests.question: INV-04 allows at most four reconciliation reads in 60 s under total network failure, but SM-SAVE sends them without that bound: T-S31 (Check again) and T-S32 (back online) read without limit, and the three automatic reads (T-S19, T-S29, ReconcileDue) are not counted against any window (Rehearsal 8 DEV-R8-11; independent review RV412-1-1). How does SM-SAVE keep within INV-04?
options: A: count every reconciliation read, automatic or not, against INV-04's own window: a read is sent only while fewer than four reconciliation reads were sent in the 60 s before RequestContext.Now, one entry per reconciliation (its commit pages and file reads are not further reads), counted per investigation session. At the limit an automatic read is rescheduled (ReconcileDue) and Check again or back-online sends nothing; Check again is offered only once the automatic reads are spent. Applies exactly the transitions and contract digests listed in 'applies' under A: T-S31, T-S32 and T-S47 replaced; T-S62, T-S63 and T-S65 added; RequestContext.Now (IF41-WIRE); InvestigationSession.ReconcileReadsSentAt and the windowed ReconcileDue (IF41-SAVE)
B: amend INV-04 to count only automatic reads (a requirement change, not in v4.1.2)
C: leave the contradiction; INV04 RequestBounds stays red
requests.recommendation: A. Every path that sends a reconciliation read checks the same window, so INV-04 holds by construction; no requirement changes and the machines stay pure.
requests.rationale: Owner choices given 2026-11-02 after the round-1 review: count every read; one reconciliation attempt is one read; re-decide.
requests.impact: Until recorded, v4.1.2 cannot be compiled with these transitions (ownerRecords).

requests.title: E1: an event union that represents every causa-storage v1.0.0 event
requests.question: Frozen CoreEvent (28 cases) cannot represent 487 of the 1,315 catalog events (proposals/r10-historical-data-compatibility/SCHEMA-DIFF.md section 2). Extend it so every stored event is representable without loss?
options: A: 00-DOMAIN-STUBS.fs CoreEvent 28 -> 50 cases: every v4.1.4 case name kept, 9 widened with the wire's fields (InvestigationActivated/Resolved/Reopened carry from; the four hypothesis transitions carry a HypothesisTransition; CauseConfirmed a CauseConfirmation; ProposalRejected a reason), 22 added, HypothesisFalsified without the Scope the wire lacks; EventEnvelope gains Provenance; payloads stay opaque (the domain owner's, with exactly the wire fields); 02-IF41-STORAGE.fs VerificationFailure gains ReaderStage (CONTRACT section 11.1)
B: keep v4.1.4 and declare the catalog unreadable (ODR-R10-25 B)
requests.recommendation: A. It is the union checks C11/C15 proved lossless on all 1,315 catalog events, and it keeps every frozen case name.
requests.rationale: ODR-R10-25 A and OD-HC-01 A (recorded) commission it.
requests.impact: Until recorded, v4.1.5's contract changes cannot pass the offline suite.

requests.title: W1 + L1: a derived workspace and listing a workspace
requests.question: No frozen contract can address a workspace or list the investigations it holds, so the build cannot browse the catalog (EXT-DATA-013) or find a working copy. Add them?
options: A: Workspace (02), WorkspaceRole Catalog | WorkingCopy and WorkspaceAddress (03), WorkspaceLister/Listing as a read with no machine state (05), Msg.ListRequested/CreateRequested and Model.Listings/ListingsInFlight (06); PathOf, Verify, VerifiedInvestigation, Initial and LoadInput.OpenRequested carry the workspace. The workspace is derived (catalog: catalog/active.json; working copy: workspaces/demo/<run>) and selected by the user (EXT-DATA-003); the J1 Connect form is unchanged
B: a workspace field on the Connect form (needs owner changes to verification/journeys)
requests.rationale: Listing and addressing are the gap SCHEMA-DIFF.md section 5 names.
requests.impact: Until recorded, v4.1.5's contract changes cannot pass the offline suite.

requests.title: C1: create a new investigation through the existing SM-SAVE states
requests.question: EXT-DATA-008 needs a command-created, round-trip-verified new investigation; SM-SAVE begins only from a verified stored history. Let a new investigation's session begin in Unsaved?
options: A: SaveMachine.InitialNew starts in Unsaved at the head just read; the first save is one commit adding StorageCodec.EncodeNew's three files, conditional on that head, Saved only from an equal read-back; every later step is an existing transition. One 'accepted' note on SM-SAVE; no state, event or transition added
B: authorize a compiler change allowing an added SM-SAVE state
requests.recommendation: A (OD-V415-04 A): X05/X12 stay as they are.
requests.rationale: PERSIST-005..007 already define the save; only its starting point is new.
requests.impact: Until recorded, v4.1.5's 05-IF41-SAVE.fs change cannot pass the offline suite.
